description_en: Creates an alias for a key
description_zh: 为主密钥（CMK）创建一个别名
name: CreateAlias

parameters.description_en: The ID of the CMK. The ID must be globally unique.

parameters.description_en:
The alias of the CMK.

The alias must be 1 to 255 characters in length and must contain the prefix `alias/`. The alias cannot be prefixed with the reserved word `alias/acs`.
